headline: ILLIT's 'BREAK EVEN' logs 3rd week on Billboard 200
sub: Only K-pop girl group on this week's chart, at No. 153
caption:
ILLIT's 'BREAK EVEN' is still going strong on the Billboard 200!

The 5th mini album placed No. 153 on the chart dated Nov 28, its third week in a row — the first ILLIT album to chart that long. ILLIT were the only K-pop girl group on this week's Billboard 200. The album also sits at No. 5 on World Albums, and title track 'You're Under Arrest' climbed to No. 4 on Melon's weekly chart.

📌 Source: Billboard, via Korean media (News1, My Daily)
